article_title: Limiting sugar before age two linked to better brain health

tasks.prompt: What is the main message of the article?
options: All sugar causes dementia immediately
Lower sugar intake before age two was linked to better brain health many decades later
Wartime rationing made children's diets less healthy
Scientists have proved that dementia can be cured by changing a baby's diet
tasks.correct_answer: Lower sugar intake before age two was linked to better brain health many decades later
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה קשר שנמצא במחקר בין צריכת סוכר נמוכה בתחילת החיים לבין בריאות מוח טובה יותר בהמשך, אך לא הוכחה סיבתיות.

tasks.prompt: What historical event allowed researchers to compare different levels of early-life sugar intake?
options: Britain's wartime sugar rationing and its end in 1953
The opening of the first supermarket in Britain
A ban on all sweets in British schools
The introduction of artificial sweeteners in hospitals
tasks.correct_answer: Britain's wartime sugar rationing and its end in 1953
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרים ניצלו את קיצוב הסוכר בבריטניה ואת סיומו בספטמבר 1953 כדי להשוות בין קבוצות שנחשפו לכמויות שונות.

tasks.prompt: What did the study report about dementia among people exposed to less sugar early in life?
options: Their risk was unchanged, but they slept better
They developed dementia ten years earlier
Their risk was about 20% lower and diagnosis was delayed by about 2.6 years among those affected
None of them developed dementia
tasks.correct_answer: Their risk was about 20% lower and diagnosis was delayed by about 2.6 years among those affected
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המחקר דיווח על ירידה של כחמישית בסיכון ועל עיכוב ממוצע של כ־2.6 שנים בהופעת המחלה אצל מי שאובחנו.

tasks.prompt: In this article, what does “rationing” mean?
options: Testing a new medicine on volunteers
Measuring sugar in the blood
Selling food only to children
Controlling and limiting how much of a product people can receive
tasks.correct_answer: Controlling and limiting how much of a product people can receive
tasks.explanation_hebrew: rationing הוא קיצוב: הגבלה וחלוקה מבוקרת של מוצר, במקרה זה סוכר בתקופת מלחמה ומחסור.

tasks.prompt: The article says the evidence is “observational”. What does that tell the reader?
options: The researchers directly controlled every person's diet for 70 years
The researchers found a pattern in existing data, so the study cannot by itself prove cause and effect
The results were based only on one doctor's opinion
The findings have already become official dietary rules
tasks.correct_answer: The researchers found a pattern in existing data, so the study cannot by itself prove cause and effect
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחקר תצפיתי מזהה קשר בנתונים קיימים, אך אינו מוכיח לבדו שהפחתת הסוכר היא שגרמה לתוצאה.

tasks.prompt: What does “lasting benefits” mean in the researchers' description?
options: Benefits available only during pregnancy
Benefits that disappear when rationing ends
Positive effects that may continue for a long time
Benefits that apply only to the researchers
tasks.correct_answer: Positive effects that may continue for a long time
tasks.explanation_hebrew: lasting benefits הם יתרונות מתמשכים, כלומר השפעות חיוביות שעשויות להישאר לאורך שנים רבות.

tasks.prompt: Why do the researchers compare people born just before and just after sugar rationing ended? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שסיום הקיצוב יצר שינוי חד יחסית בחשיפה לסוכר, ולכן אפשר להשוות קבוצות דומות מתקופות סמוכות.
expected_points: The end of rationing created a clear change in available sugar
The groups were born in nearby periods and can be compared
The comparison helps identify an association with early-life sugar exposure

tasks.prompt: Write a 60–90 word summary of the article without copying sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את קיצוב הסוכר, מאגר הנתונים, התוצאות לגבי דמנציה ואת ההסתייגות שהמחקר אינו מוכיח סיבתיות.
expected_points: Researchers studied about 65,000 people using UK Biobank data
They compared exposure during and after wartime sugar rationing
Lower early-life sugar was associated with lower or later dementia risk
The evidence is observational and not definitive proof

tasks.prompt: Explain in 3–4 sentences why the headline uses “linked to” rather than “caused”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין מתאם לסיבתיות ולציין שהחוקרים ניתחו נתונים היסטוריים ולא הקצו דיאטות בניסוי מבוקר.
expected_points: The study found an association between early sugar exposure and later brain health
It was not a controlled experiment
Other differences between the groups may have influenced the results
The cautious wording avoids claiming proof of causation

tasks.prompt: Choose one result from the article and one reason for caution, and explain both in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין תוצאה מספרית או ממצא מוחי ממשי, ולצדה מגבלה כגון אופיו התצפיתי של המחקר או הצורך במחקרים נוספים.
expected_points: Identify a concrete result such as the 20% lower risk or 2.6-year delay
Identify the observational design or another stated limitation
Keep the conclusion proportional to the evidence
